label: SECONDARY / post-primary. Not part of the frozen GO/KILL decision, frozen floor, or V1.

ego_axis.definition: sensor-frame BEV displacement (≥0.5 m) crossed with world-frame BEV displacement (≥0.5 m); frame 0 excluded
ego_axis.note: BEV (xy) matches the 21 Nov GT census in SECONDARY_ANALYSES.md #1. Primary motion bins stay 3D world-frame gt_motion, as frozen.

floor_vs_noego_by_ego_cell.note: Validity check (not a discriminator): the no-ego floor (frozen control 3) should collapse versus the ego-compensated floor in ego-only frames.

R_progress_BAT_to_best_learned.status: KITTI-only. The pre-specified informative/uninformative call needs BAT and best-learned on both KITTI and nuScenes. Formal #2 is also labelled moot for the paper as planned if a formal KILL is later called; this is a diagnostic write-up.

hego_rule.text: SECONDARY #1 NO-GO: |Δgap| < 2 and the oxts-compensated gain is <1. Ego pose is not the source of the learned−floor gap (fairness objection defused).

rule.GO: Δgap ≤ −3 and 95% CI excludes 0, AND oxts M2-Track gain ≥2 on ego-only (overall ≥1)

hego_rule.applied_to: Δgap from uncompensated M2-Track vs floor; gain from M2-Track-oxts vs M2-Track

bat_informational.note: Informational only; not a V1 gate. Open3DSOT README warns that reproducing the 65.37 checkpoint figure needs CUDA 10.x; this run was on a Kaggle T4 (CUDA 11/12) and may drift. BAT is used only as a relative anchor.
